test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 24 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A sum of money lent on simple interest becomes (8)/(5) of itself in 4 years. Find the rate of interest per annum.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let **Principal** = 5 units, then **Amount** = 8 units.

**Simple Interest** = Amount − Principal = 8 − 5 = 3 units.

Rate (R) = (SI × 100) ÷ (P × T) = (3 × 100) ÷ (5 × 4).

R = 300 ÷ 20 = 15%.

**∴ The correct answer is 15%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** Amount (A) = 8/5 of Principal (P), Time (T) = 4 years.

**Formula Used:** SI = (P × R × T) / 100; Amount = P + SI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/26d26525d339e8ce238c223b55b34b64b3d62504ee25bc937a13cc7246f9c914.png] 

⇒ Amount = P + SI

⇒ 8/5 P = P + SI

⇒ SI = 8/5 P − P = 3/5 P

⇒ 3/5 P = (P × R × 4) / 100

⇒ 3/5 = (R × 4) / 100

⇒ R = (3 × 100) / (5 × 4)

⇒ R = 300 / 20 = 15%

**∴ The correct answer is 15%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest Formula

The basic formula is SI = (P × R × T) / 100, where P is principal, R is rate %, and T is time in years.

Relation between Amount and SI

Amount (A) is the sum of Principal (P) and Interest (I). A = P(1 + RT/100).

Rate Calculation

Rate per annum can be calculated as R = (SI × 100) / (P × T).</p
